- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

Now — one important verification: when the span originally accumulated, the buffer got those lines via `consumeLine` while `_inFence == false`. During the replay, `_savedFence` restores `inFence` and the seed fills the buffer. `_fmt.consumeLine(boundaryLine)` then flushes. The output should be identical provided:
1. The seed rows are byte-identical to the original buffer rows. ✓ (same src lines)
2. `_inFence` state matches what it was when the span accumulated. `_savedFence = _fenceBeforeBoundaryLine` in the rollback — the fence state just before the boundary line, which is the same state present when the boundary line was originally consumed. And the span rows before the boundary were consumed under earlier fence states — if a fence opened/closed within the span, the rows would not be table rows anyway (fence content isn't table rows)... Actually if `_inFence` was true when a `|...|` line arrived, it wouldn't be buffered. The buffered rows were consumed with `_inFence == false` for each. During replay all seed rows are in the buffer directly (not re-consumed), so fence state doesn't affect them. ✓

3. The boundary line during replay is the GROWN line (longer than the committed boundary). Ah wait — this is the key difference! The committed outputs embedded the grid + the boundary line formatted as it was THEN (e.g., `Итог готов`). The replay flushes the SAME grid, but formats the boundary line in its GROWN form (`Итог готов2. Issue два`). That's exactly the intent — the tail grew, so the line re-renders longer. The rollback mechanism (`_srcFmtStarts[edge]`) truncates the boundary line's old formatted output so only the new render shows. ✓ Byte-exact for the grid; the line itself is re-rendered fresh. Good.

One more check: in `_rollbackGrownTail`, `_boundaryLast = edge > 0 ? src[edge - 1] : null;` — sets the new boundary to the line BEFORE the rolled-back line. And `_boundaryFirst` unchanged (head intact — verified by the identity check earlier in the method). ✓

Now — the `_boundaryClosedPendingTable` reset in the rollback: it sets `_boundaryClosedPendingTable = false` and `_boundaryPendingFrom = -1`, then arms `_pendingSeedTable = seed`. If the subsequent walk is throttled (returns before walking), the latched state stays false/-1 with the seed armed — the doc says the re-walk re-latches from its own commit. But what if the next sync does ANOTHER rollback attempt before walking? Can `_rollbackGrownTail` be called twice in a row without a walk in between? sync(): if `!_resumable(src) && !_rollbackGrownTail(src)` → rebuild. If the rollback succeeded, sync continues to walk (or throttle-returns). If throttled, the NEXT sync re-offers the same src — `_resumable(src)`: after the rollback, `_boundaryLast = src[edge-1]` — the line before the boundary. - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.

If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4

- **Deletions**: -9

- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +373
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T19:16:16Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# gh-1573: [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

```dart
await env.writeFile(_globalConfig, _validGlobal);
final homeEnv = MemoryExecutionEnv(cwd: '/home');
final homeService = ConfigService(env: homeEnv, homeDir: '/home');
await homeEnv.writeFile(_globalConfig, _validGlobal);

```

The first `env.writeFile` appears redundant (the outer `env` isn't used by homeService). Let me look at the test's setUp to see if `env` is created with cwd '/home' as well... If setUp creates `env = MemoryExecutionEnv(cwd: '/somewhere')`, then the first write is unnecessary noise — a SUGGESTION. Let me read the test file around the new test.

3. Check `_tailThrottleMinLength` interplay: `_tailThrottled` requires `src.last.length > 8192`. In the seeded-rollback-then-throttle path — fine.

4. Now think about whether `_rollbackTableSeed`'s refusal condition `src.length != _through` misses a REAL case: in-place growth (src.length == _through) is the common case ✓; chunk-split refuses → rebuild ✓. What about the case where the boundary line SHRANK (chunk-split where _through-1 is not the first chunk... `_boundarySurvivesAsChunks` concatenates from _through-1 and checks startsWith — requires the first chunk at index _through-1 ✓).

5. One more scenario for the seed path: boundary closed table; the tail grows; rollback + seed armed; walk from edge re-flushes grid; commit re-latches `_boundaryClosedPendingTable=true`, `_boundaryPendingFrom` = true span start. Tail grows again → second rollback → `_rollbackTableSeed` returns the span rows again ✓. Multiple rollback cycles work. The doc mentions this ("across rollback cycles"). ✓

6. Think about `_boundaryLast` after rollback: `edge > 0 ? src[edge-1] : null`. If edge == 0 (boundary was the FIRST line — the transcript's first line closed a table? Impossible: a table needs an opener before the closer; the opener would before line 0 — impossible. Actually the boundary line at index 0 closing a pending table: `_boundaryClosedPendingTable` true requires buffer non-empty before line 0 — the parser state at line 0 is always fresh-empty. So `from >= _through - 1` guard would catch it anyway (from < 0). And `_rollbackTableSeed` checks `from < 0 → refuse` ✓. But wait — if `_boundaryClosedPendingTable` is true and `_boundaryPendingFrom` == -1, refuse → rebuild. Can that state exist? `_commitTo` sets `_boundaryPendingFrom = -1` when `!_boundaryClosedPendingTable`. When true, pendingStartAt[upto-1] ≥ 0... For a boundary at index 0 with tableBefore[0] true: pendingStartAt[0] — top of loop: hasPendingTable (from seed? no, from==0 walk, no seed) — fresh parser has empty buffer → tableBefore[0] = false. So a line-0 boundary never latches true. ✓ Consistent.

7. Cross-check the sync() early return `if (src.length == _through) return _viewFormatted;` — with the rollback NOT taken and resumable true... fine, pre-existing.

8. Now the config_service change — one more consideration: the early `return report;` skips the project pass. Any state that the project pass mutates for LATER use? The function ends right after; `report` is returned. ✓ No `set`-style side effects. ✓

9. Also check: are there OTHER ConfigService methods with the same cwd==home double-pass issue that the ticket mentions ("It should detect the same path and skip the project pass")? The ticket only names `check`. `get()` reads both files (project doc read + global fallback) — double-READ is harmless for get (same bytes, same values — project scope wins; consistent). `set` writes to one scope explicitly — fine.

10. Test coverage for the `widthOverrideForTest` resize path with a pending seed — `_rebuild` clears the seed ✓, but is there a test? The new tests don't cover resize-after-rollback-with-armed-seed. Minor gap — SUGGESTION level. Actually wait — there IS a subtle potential bug here: rollback arms `_pendingSeedTable`; the SAME sync then walks (seed consumed). Between syncs, if the width changes (resize), `_resumable` false → rebuild → `_pendingSeedTable = null` ✓ covered by the guard. But what if rollback succeeds and the throttle returns, THEN width changes → resumable false (width) → `_rollbackGrownTail`? width != _fmt.width → false → `_rebuild` → seed cleared ✓. Good — no stale seed path.

11. What about `sync()` when rollback succeeded but then `_walk` throws? No exception paths expected (parser is total). Skip.

12. Let me now also verify the test helper `checkOrThrow` and the `expectParityUnderDeltas` mutation semantics — `src` param is the SAME list instance mutated across calls (test 2: `src.addAll` between calls ✓).

13. Let me double check the 4th test's regex: `RegExp('\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m')` — Dart string: `\x1b\[` ... escaped bracket ✓ matches SGR only, not other CSI — fine for stripping color from view content.

Now — one important verification: when the span originally accumulated, the buffer got those lines via `consumeLine` while `_inFence == false`. During the replay, `_savedFence` restores `inFence` and the seed fills the buffer. `_fmt.consumeLine(boundaryLine)` then flushes. The output should be identical provided:
1. The seed rows are byte-identical to the original buffer rows. ✓ (same src lines)
2. `_inFence` state matches what it was when the span accumulated. `_savedFence = _fenceBeforeBoundaryLine` in the rollback — the fence state just before the boundary line, which is the same state present when the boundary line was originally consumed. And the span rows before the boundary were consumed under earlier fence states — if a fence opened/closed within the span, the rows would not be table rows anyway (fence content isn't table rows)... Actually if `_inFence` was true when a `|...|` line arrived, it wouldn't be buffered. The buffered rows were consumed with `_inFence == false` for each. During replay all seed rows are in the buffer directly (not re-consumed), so fence state doesn't affect them. ✓

3. The boundary line during replay is the GROWN line (longer than the committed boundary). Ah wait — this is the key difference! The committed outputs embedded the grid + the boundary line formatted as it was THEN (e.g., `Итог готов`). The replay flushes the SAME grid, but formats the boundary line in its GROWN form (`Итог готов2. Issue два`). That's exactly the intent — the tail grew, so the line re-renders longer. The rollback mechanism (`_srcFmtStarts[edge]`) truncates the boundary line's old formatted output so only the new render shows. ✓ Byte-exact for the grid; the line itself is re-rendered fresh. Good.

One more check: in `_rollbackGrownTail`, `_boundaryLast = edge > 0 ? src[edge - 1] : null;` — sets the new boundary to the line BEFORE the rolled-back line. And `_boundaryFirst` unchanged (head intact — verified by the identity check earlier in the method). ✓

Now — the `_boundaryClosedPendingTable` reset in the rollback: it sets `_boundaryClosedPendingTable = false` and `_boundaryPendingFrom = -1`, then arms `_pendingSeedTable = seed`. If the subsequent walk is throttled (returns before walking), the latched state stays false/-1 with the seed armed — the doc says the re-walk re-latches from its own commit. But what if the next sync does ANOTHER rollback attempt before walking? Can `_rollbackGrownTail` be called twice in a row without a walk in between? sync(): if `!_resumable(src) && !_rollbackGrownTail(src)` → rebuild. If the rollback succeeded, sync continues to walk (or throttle-returns). If throttled, the NEXT sync re-offers the same src — `_resumable(src)`: after the rollback, `_boundaryLast = src[edge-1]` — the line before the boundary. What if, after a rollback, `_resumable` fails (e.g. src shrunk / replaced) and `_rollbackGrownTail` is attempted again? `_tailIsFaithfulGrowth(src, boundary)` with boundary = src[edge-1] — the new boundary is a COMPLETE line (src[edge-1] unchanged)... `grown = src[_through-1]` where _through = edge → grown = src[edge-1] = boundary itself → equal lengths → return false → rollback refused → `_rebuild(src)` → `_rebuild` clears `_pendingSeedTable` ("a refused rollback's seed never survives"). ✓ Good — that guard matters because `_rebuild` uses a FRESH AnsiMarkdown and the seed must not leak into it.

Hmm, but wait — does `_rebuild`'s `_pendingSeedTable = null` cover all refusal paths? What about sync's rebuild path when `_resumable` is false AND rollback refused: `_rollbackGrownTail` returns false BEFORE arming the seed in some paths — but `_rollbackTableSeed` refusal → `return false` without arming ✓. If rollback succeeded but then... rollback succeeding always returns true from `_rollbackGrownTail`, so no rebuild after that in the same sync. ✓

One more: `_walk` consumes the seed (`_pendingSeedTable = null`) at the START — before any early return in the walk? The walk has no early returns. ✓

Now what about the `widthOverrideForTest` (resize) path: width change → `_resumable` false → rollback refused (width check) → rebuild → seed cleared ✓.

If src.length > _through, then src[_through-1] (the boundary) is NOT the last line. For `_tailIsFaithfulGrowth` to pass with src.length > _through, we need `grown.length < boundary.length` (chunk-split case) — because grown.length > boundary.length requires... wait no. `_tailIsFaithfulGrowth(src, boundary)`:

- if grown.length > boundary.length → grown.startsWith(boundary)  ← in-place growth

If service lines were appended after the boundary line, the boundary line was complete (newline-terminated) at commit time... then it never grows anymore (it's not the tail).
